description: This file is a C header defining structures, function prototypes, macros, and external references related to 'trees' in a version control context (likely Git). It declares structures for repository trees, functions for parsing, comparing pathnames, and reading trees, as well as external variables and function macros used for managing tree objects.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Looks up a tree object in a repository based on an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a buffer into a tree object.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Parses a tree in a gentle manner, not throwing errors but indicating missing objects.

methods.name: int repo_parse_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * item)
methods.description: Default macro for parsing a tree without quiet mode.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Parses an indirect tree object, following tags and commits.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a tree's buffer.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares two base names with modes.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compare directory file names with modes.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Reads a tree at a specific path and depth, applying a callback function.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Reads a tree with specified pathspecs, applying a callback function.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)

ctags.name: repo_parse_tree
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int repo_parse_tree(struct repository *r, struct tree *item)$/
